hypotheses.hypothesis: A typed proof-carrying receipt lattice can replace free-form causal support IDs and nearly eliminate false causal/effect completion acceptance at low cost.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Graph closure validation is too expensive/complex for hot-path use.
hypotheses.evidence: local 10k mutation falsifier: lattice 0 false accepts; naive IDs 85.72%; p50 validation ~20.7us.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Product-key addressing can be a high-capacity AI-native derived memory field when current keys lie on a validated product manifold.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Off-manifold/OOD drift makes structured addressing unsafe or slower than brute/ANN fallback.
hypotheses.evidence: 65,536 structured slots: exact parity with brute top1 at ~2.4-2.6x p50 speed; non-product control: 0 recall.

hypotheses.hypothesis: A conservative learned/adaptive router can select approximate memory fields while preserving exact-result parity through abstention/fallback.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Gate overhead and calibration drift erase speed gains and can introduce false routes.
hypotheses.evidence: stable sweeps show larger-scale mean gains but fragile p50 and nonzero false-route events for naive thresholds; margin/topk can restore parity in some configurations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Incremental delta maintenance should replace full projection rebuild for ClayGraph/FTS when updates are sparse.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Delta bookkeeping dominates or diverges under complex recursive queries.
hypotheses.evidence: 30k synthetic records, 1% batches: ~20.6x median maintenance speedup with exact equivalence.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hyperdimensional/VSA superposition is useful as an exploratory associative field but not as canonical exact relation storage.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Capacity scaling can be increased enough to replace explicit exact relation structures.
hypotheses.evidence: 4096D field: recall drops from 1.0 at 100 bindings to ~0.82 at 300, with rising latency.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Periodic Merkle epoch checkpoints can cheaply make canonical history tamper-evident and proof-addressable.
hypotheses.counterhypothesis: Existing root-hash chain is sufficient and Merkle structure adds unnecessary write/operational complexity.
hypotheses.evidence: 20k local event prototype: tamper detected; append hash p50 sub-us; proof size 288B for 512-leaf segment.
